home.hero: Your baby's health, in one place. With AI grounded in research.
home.subhero: For the questions that keep you up at night: gather your baby's history and ask in plain language. Every answer backed by research, and cited.
home.eyebrow: For moms · baby health with evidence
home.proofQuestion: Is it normal for my baby to spit up after every feed?
home.proofAnswer: Regurgitation is common in infants and usually resolves by 12 months without treatment; red flags are weight loss, feed refusal or blood.
home.feature1Body: Every report on your baby, encrypted in a private vault. You decide what's shared and with whom.
home.feature2Body: No vague answers: every interpretation is backed by real pediatric studies and guidelines, cited and verifiable.
home.feature3Body: Generate a clear summary for the visit. The pediatrician grasps the case in 30 seconds.
home.modesTitle: Ask about your baby. Or prep them for the pediatrician.
home.modeABody: Query your baby's records in plain language and get cited answers: weight and height curve, vaccines, what each doctor said — and what the research says about it.
home.modeAEx1: Is their weight curve within the normal range?
home.modeAEx2: Is it normal to spit up after every feed?
home.modeAEx3: Summarize their recent check-ups and flag any alerts
home.modeBBody: Generate a one-page summary, shareable via secure link or PDF. The specialist grasps your baby in 30 seconds, with no retelling their history.
home.modeBEx3: Ephemeral link or PDF: you control what is shown
home.ossEyebrow: Open source · Your data under your control
home.ossTitle: Free software you can host yourself
home.ossBody: AdelIA is open source under AGPL-3.0. Host it on your own server, bring your own AI key (BYOK) or use the free tier. No lock-in, and your medical data is never sold to anyone.
home.footerTagline: Made for moms. Your baby's health vault, with AI and evidence.
home.footerDisclaimer: Personal health documentation tool. It does not replace medical advice and is not a medical device.
home.footerLicense: AGPL-3.0 · Made with care by Godi.AI
home.modeADemoQ: When should I worry about spit-up?
home.modeADemoA: Red flags are weight loss, food refusal or blood; without them it's usually physiological and improves by the first year.
home.modeBDemoS1: Mild physiological reflux, improving. Vaccines up to date.
home.modeBDemoS2: Weight and height curve within expected percentiles.
home.modeBDemoS3: Should we review the introduction of solid foods?
home.evTitle: Every answer is born from a study. Literally.
home.evBody: AdelIA doesn't answer from a black box. It retrieves and cites peer-reviewed pediatric research — and if none backs your question, it says so instead of making it up.
home.vsTitle: Same question. Two very different answers.
home.vsQuestion: “Is it safe to give my baby an antacid for reflux?”
home.vsGptAnswer: Antacids can generally be used in babies, but you should check with your pediatrician. Every case is different and there are several options.
home.vsGptNote: No source. Doesn't know your baby. Sounds safe even when it's wrong.
home.vsAdeliaAnswer: The evidence does not support routine acid suppression for regurgitation in healthy infants; it's reserved for confirmed reflux disease.
home.vsAdeliaNote: Backed by a specific, cited, verifiable study. And cross-checked with your baby's history.
home.vsR1L: Cites the study it comes from
home.prTitle: You choose how much we manage for you.
home.prT1Desc: Download the software, bring your own AI keys and host it yourself. Maximum privacy, full control.
home.prT2Desc: We host and maintain it, with the AI included. You just upload reports and ask.
home.prT3Desc: Everything in Managed, plus a monthly review by a pediatric specialist based on what your baby needs.
home.prT3F3: Specialist matched to the topic (reflux, sleep, feeding…)
home.prT3F4: Answers with your briefing in hand
home.prFootnote: Indicative prices, in validation. The specialist review is async; live teleconsults will arrive in a higher plan.
home.mixTitle: Their full history, from birth — cross-checked with research.
home.mixBody: AdelIA doesn't answer in the abstract. It combines every data point about your baby, from day one, with 1,936 studies to give you an answer made for them — not for “some baby”.
home.mixAnswer: Your baby went from 3.2 kg at birth to 7.4 kg at 6 months [2]: a gain within the expected range per WHO growth curves [ev_1]. The reflux you logged at 4 months matches the physiological peak described by NASPGHAN-ESPGHAN, which improves toward the first year [ev_2].

email.title: Email forwarding
email.subtitle: Every medical document you receive by email — forward it to your unique alias and it will be ingested automatically.

email.gmailStep2: 2. Match emails from your hospital / doctor
email.warning: Emails forwarded to your alias are processed automatically. Only forward medical content you want in your vault.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.dangerBody: Deleting your account permanently erases all your documents, entities, briefings, chats, profiles and share links, including the original files. This action is NOT reversible (right to erasure, GDPR art. 17).
